temporis evidentior est, quam ut in litem vocari posset.
Hinc confecimus in Oriente nequaquam, & speciatim
non inter Antiochenos & Seleucienses in usu fuisse æ-

nitur in prologo.

"Norisius" and "Asiæ" are printed with a long s, transcribed as plain s. The Greek sigma is printed as in the original. The §10 paragraph is printed as a full paragraph, so no line-break note is needed. The §11 paragraph runs over the page break and is cut off at "ubi"; the catchword "qua-" is given below.
